The '''Sub-70 ice mines''' were a set of [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. The mines were so-named because they were all located south of seventy degrees of latitude, near the planet's ice caps. The mines were formerlly owned by [[South Bandomeer Consalidated]] and had a reputation for being a deadly work environment. Though the mining was difficult, it was not as dangerous as the mines' reputation suggested.<ref name="GatORW" />
